factSources.text: With Venus in Cancer, affection shows through care, memory, home, food, and the desire to make someone feel safe. You value devotion that feels emotionally real.

factSources.text: Venus describes attraction, pleasure, beauty, values, money, comfort, desire, and the conditions that help connection feel worth choosing. It shows what someone is drawn toward and what helps affection become real rather than only appealing. Venus moves through all twelve signs in about a year, with retrograde cycles that ask for review around love, value, beauty, money, and desire. Its sign describes the style of relating; its house shows where ease, attraction, and value become active. With Venus in Cancer, your love is nurturing, protective, and deep. Home and family are central to your sense of comfort and security in a relationship.

eventsDuringTransit.meaning: Love and value meet imagination. Heightened artistic sensibility and romantic idealism. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Seeing what you want to see in love, idealizing others, and the disillusionment that follows. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

Affection and value meet limit. Loyalty, restraint in pleasure and love, and a strong sense of obligation. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Difficulty enjoying success, fear of loss, blocked rewards, and free-floating guilt. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.
